summary: Verified both new features end-to-end. FEATURE 1 (Contingency %): contingency-input renders in Quote Builder alongside Overhead % and Profit %. Live quote-breakdown shows a 'Contingency (10%)' row with the correct amount. Formula validated on backend: direct 6000 @10% contingency => contingency 600, overheads 660, profit 1089, gst 834.9, final 9183.9 (matches spec exactly). UI verified with 1×$120 Concrete slab line: Direct $120 + Cont 10% $12 + OH 10% $13.20 + Profit 15% $21.78 + GST $16.70 = $183.68. Quote saved and re-opened via detail view: contingency row persists (Q-0003). FEATURE 2 (Any-direction status): detail-status-DRAFT/SENT/ACCEPTED/REJECTED/EXPIRED chips all render on quote-detail-view. Successfully transitioned DRAFT→ACCEPTED (forward), ACCEPTED→DRAFT (backward), DRAFT→REJECTED, REJECTED→EXPIRED, EXPIRED→ACCEPTED. detail-tojob button appears exactly when status is ACCEPTED. Backend PATCH /api/quotes/{id}/status confirmed to accept any direction (added test test_quote_create_with_contingency_and_status_any_direction). Regression: quote list loads with 3 quotes, quote detail shows line items + breakdown + version history + Valid until date. Jobs tab: job detail modal shows job-status-* chips (SCHEDULED/IN_PROGRESS/ON_HOLD/COMPLETED visible; CANCELLED is horizontally scrolled off-screen), progress-plus & progress-minus work, status change to IN_PROGRESS persisted. Backend tests: 14/15 pass — the only failure (test_auth_me) is a pre-existing unrelated email-case assertion, not related to this iteration. Cosmetic: same RN-web deprecation warnings as prior iteration (shadow* / pointerEvents).

minor.issue: Pre-existing test_auth_me assertion is case-sensitive on email; backend lowercases emails on register. Not a product bug — fix assertion to compare via .lower().

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props deprecated — migrate to boxShadow. Non-blocking, warnings only.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated — use style.pointerEvents. Non-blocking.

(Cosmetic) Migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents (non-blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: Quote builder correctly threads contingency_percentage into POST /api/quotes and live preview via /api/calculate-quote. Formula direct→+contingency→+overheads(on direct+contingency)→+profit→+GST(10%) matches spec.
quote-detail-view Adjust status row uses a plain PATCH allowing any-direction transitions with immediate re-fetch and highlighted active chip via chipActive style.
detail-tojob button correctly gated by detail.status === 'ACCEPTED'.

All required testIDs present and stable: contingency-input, quote-breakdown, quote-add-button, builder-save, add-line-button, quote-title-input, quote-<id>, quote-detail-view, detail-item-<idx>, detail-status-<STATE>, detail-tojob, quote-detail-close.
Jobs screen retains job-status-* chips and progress-plus/-minus with working PATCH.

seed_data_creation: Created Q-0003 'TEST_Contingency_<ts>' (1×$120 Concrete slab, 10% contingency) via UI; walked it through all 5 statuses ending on ACCEPTED. Also cycled the pre-existing Q-0001 job to IN_PROGRESS at 10% via regression check.
